findings.title: A retried save after a partial failure loses the fact that the router was turned on.
findings.body:
`turnedOn` comes only from what this attempt sends. Here is how that fails: the user opens the sheet with **Turn on** and also renames the router. The routing PUT with `enabled: true` succeeds, so the router is now live, but the name PUT fails (for example, the name is taken). `enabled` is now part of the baseline. The retry sends only the name, so `turnedOn` is false. The user then sees "Router saved" instead of the turned-on toast, and `onSaved` does not take them back to the overview, even though this sheet turned the router on.

The fix is to work out `turnedOn` from the router as the sheet opened, not from the last request. `onSaved` is also only called on full success, so if the user cancels after the partial failure, the page is never told the router went live.
